login.identifierRequired: Enter your username or e-mail address.
login.invalidAdvice: Check the spelling of your username and that Caps Lock is off, then try again. After a few attempts the "Forgot password?" link appears so you can ask your administrator to reset it.
login.rejectedTitle: Your account cannot sign in right now.
login.rejectedAdvice: Contact your company administrator to find out why and restore access.
login.throttledTitle: Too many sign-in attempts in a short time.
login.throttledAdvice: For security, access is temporarily blocked. Wait {{wait}} before trying again.
login.timeoutTitle: The server took too long to respond.
login.networkAdvice: Check your internet connection (Wi-Fi or mobile data), then try again. Your username and password were not rejected.
login.unavailableAdvice: An update or restart is probably in progress. Wait a minute, then try again.
login.serverTitle: An error occurred on our side while signing in.
login.serverAdvice: Your username and password are not the problem. Try again in a moment; if it persists, contact support.

departments.nameRequired: Enter the name of the department or service.
departments.nameTooLong: The name is too long ({{count}} characters): 255 characters maximum.
departments.codeRequired: Enter a short code of at most 4 characters (example: DSI, DAF).
departments.codeInvalidChars: The code must not contain spaces or commas: it is used as an identifier in import files.
departments.nameDuplicate: A department or service named "{{name}}" already exists: choose another name.
departments.codeDuplicate: The code "{{code}}" is already used by "{{owner}}": choose a unique code.
departments.parentMissing: The chosen parent department is no longer in the list: refresh the page and try again.
departments.parentIsService: A service cannot belong to another service: attach it to a department.

teams.firstNameRequired: Enter the team member's first name.
teams.lastNameRequired: Enter the team member's last name.
teams.emailRequired: Enter the team member's e-mail address.
teams.emailInvalid: The e-mail address "{{email}}" is not valid (example: first.last@company.com).
teams.emailDuplicate: The address "{{email}}" is already used by {{name}}: enter another address.
teams.passwordTooShort: The temporary password must be at least 8 characters long (it has {{count}}).
teams.noTeam: No team is selected: close the window and reopen it from the relevant team.

companies.nameTooLong: The company name is too long ({{count}} characters): 255 maximum.
companies.employeeCountInvalid: Headcount must be a whole number, zero or more (example: 120).
companies.adminNamesBoth: Fill in both the CEO's first and last name, or leave both empty: an account cannot be created with an incomplete name.
companies.deleteMismatch: The text entered does not exactly match "{{name}}".
companies.planSame: This is already the current plan: choose another one.

bulkUpload.companyRequired: Choose the company to import the users into.
bulkUpload.fileRequired: Choose a CSV file to import.
bulkUpload.notCsv: "{{name}}" is not a CSV file: choose a file whose name ends in .csv.
bulkUpload.excelFile: "{{name}}" is an Excel workbook. Open it, then choose File > Save As > CSV UTF-8 (comma delimited) and import that file.
bulkUpload.tooLarge: The file is {{size}} MB: the limit is {{max}} MB. Split it into several files.
bulkUpload.badEncoding: The file is not UTF-8 encoded (accented characters are unreadable). Save it again as CSV UTF-8.
bulkUpload.wrongSeparator: Columns are separated by semicolons or tabs. Save the file with a comma (,) as separator, as in the template.
bulkUpload.missingColumns: Required column(s) missing from the first line: {{columns}}. Download the template to get the right headings.
bulkUpload.noRows: The file only contains the header: add at least one user row.

skillsAdmin.matrixNameRequired: Enter the framework name (example: Finance & Administration Director).
skillsAdmin.matrixDuplicate: A "{{name}}" framework of type {{type}} already exists for this company: choose another name or the other type.
skillsAdmin.itemDuplicate: The skill "{{name}}" already exists in this framework: edit it instead of adding a second one.
skillsAdmin.weightInvalid: The weight must be a number strictly greater than 0 (example: 1 or 1.5).
skillsAdmin.weightDecimals: The weight accepts at most 2 decimals.

profile.phoneInvalid: The phone number "{{phone}}" is not valid: use only digits, spaces and optionally a leading + (6 to 15 digits).
profile.firstNameTooLong: The first name is too long: 150 characters maximum.
profile.lastNameTooLong: The last name is too long: 150 characters maximum.
profile.positionTooLong: The position is too long: 255 characters maximum.
profile.avatarNotImage: The profile photo "{{name}}" is not a JPG, PNG, WebP or GIF image.
profile.avatarTooLarge: The profile photo is {{size}} MB: the limit is {{max}} MB. Choose a lighter image.
profile.fullBodyNotImage: The full-body photo "{{name}}" is not a JPG, PNG, WebP or GIF image.
profile.fullBodyTooLarge: The full-body photo is {{size}} MB: the limit is {{max}} MB. Choose a lighter image.

changePassword.tooShort: The new password must be at least 8 characters long (it has {{count}}).
changePassword.digitsOnly: The new password cannot consist only of digits: add letters.
changePassword.sameAsOld: The new password is the same as the current one: choose a different one.
changePassword.confirmRequired: Enter the new password again in the confirmation field.
changePassword.mismatch: The new password and its confirmation are not identical.

logs.dateOrder: The start date ({{from}}) is after the end date ({{to}}): no event can match. Swap the two dates.
logs.exportFailed: The log export could not be generated. Your filters are kept: try again in a moment.
